newsitem.title: USA: US steel shipments up 7.3 pct in January-AISI.
newsitem.headline: US steel shipments up 7.3 pct in January-AISI.

text.p: U.S. steel mills shipped 8,629,918 net tons of steel during January, up 7.3 percent form the 8,043,143 net tons shipped the preceding month, the American Iron and Steel Institute said Tuesday.
Shipments in Janauary also were 5.5 percent higher than in January 1996.

By category, shipments to service centers and distributers were down 6.3 percent; automotive up 12.3 percent; construction and contractors' products, up 4.4 percent; oil and gas, down 0.1 percent; machinery, industrial equipment and tools, down 15.2 percent; appliances, utensils and cutlery, down 6.7 percent; containers, packaging and shipping materials, up 17.7 percent and electrical equipment, up 10.3 percent.
